text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    branches:
      - main
      - dev

jobs:
  claude-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Claude Code Review
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@beta
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          # Configure Claude to review the PR changes
          claude_arguments: |
            --prompt "Please review this pull request. Focus on:
            1. Correct usage of @liam-hq/pglite-server's executeQuery function
            2. Proper error handling for DDL execution
            3. Type safety and TypeScript best practices
            4. Logging consistency with existing workflow nodes
            5. Security implications of executing DDL statements
            
            Provide specific feedback on the changes in executeDDLNode.ts and any other modified files."
```
